name: bn10
description: BitNode 10: sleeve controller and Covenant purchases, plus the bn15 darknet family (The Red Pill can come from the 4th lab in BN10).
notes: Extends bn15 for the darknet scripts and dnet_root.js; bn10 config overrides bn15 BN15-tuned player_activity_config.json with the neutral one. startup.js launches the manifest startup list (dnet_root.js, then sleeve_controller.js, about 26GB) after core. sleeve_buyer.js (startup) buys sleeve augmentations at once and Covenant sleeves and memory after joining; set covenantTarget true near 20 installs.
